title: Quick Hits — National firsts
summary: : 8 cheetahs from Botswana joining Kuno (3rd translocation batch, Project Cheetah, population now 53).

items: : 8 cheetahs from Botswana joining Kuno (3rd translocation batch, Project Cheetah, population now 53).
V.O. Chidambaranar Port — India's 1st Digital Twin port platform.
India's 1st hydrogen trainset (ICF Chennai, Jind-Sonipat trial).
APSEZ's Port of Refuge — Dighi (west) + Gopalpur (east), India's 1st.
India's 1st riverine lighthouses on Brahmaputra (₹84 crore, solar).
India's 1st Integrated OTEC plant (Kavaratti) — world first-mover ahead of Japan/US.
25 MT GI-tagged Assam Joha Rice exported to UK/Italy.
National Dental Commission replaces Dental Council of India (in force 19 March 2026).
Energy Statistics India 2026 (33rd edn) — renewable potential 47,04,043 MW.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Port of Refuge (Dighi+Gopalpur) and hydrogen trainset (Jind-Sonipat) most exam-likely.
